title: RECOVERY CONSOLE
description: RESTORE WORKING SPOOL. RETAIN SEALED ORIGINALS.

prerequisites.missingEvidence: Q17 proof required. Verify the deferred release at either Q17 desk.
Training required. Learn the procedure at The Forgotten Archive shelf.

operations.outOfOrder: SEAL requires an untouched original. Review the training notebook and retry.
ROUTE needs a seal reference. Review the training notebook and retry.
ACK needs a destination receipt. Review the training notebook and retry.

orderCheck.prompt: Apply the training shelf procedure. Select operations or type APPLY with the operations separated by /.
orderCheck.invalidOrder: Enter each operation once, separated by /. Review the training notebook and retry.
